description: Bring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central financial statements into Power BI without rebuilding the report structure. This visual lets you present financial statement layouts directly in Power BI—making it easier to share standardized P&L, Balance Sheet, and other statement formats with interactive filtering and a consistent look across your reporting. No need to rewrite the GL Accounts. Just export them from BC (e.g. with configuration package and use it directly in Power BI. Key features are: 1. Standard PL together in one tab or tabs 2. Reporting on Account categories and sub categories 3. Build your own Key Values 4. Use Dupont Pyramids 5. Can be used as table or Matrix. 6. Highly configurable. 7. Drill Through 8. Expand and collapse rows. 9. Hide rows with zero in values. 10. Easy to get started.
keywords: SOAK Dynamics 365 Business Central Financials Visual
